manual.external_heater.line2: {0}The External Heater generates heat from Flux, which it outputs to the heat vents on its sides.{1}
manual.external_heater.line3: It cannot produce the reducing atmospheres used in Blast Furnaces, woodsmoke for food preservation, or temperatures necessary for kilns.{0}
manual.external_heater.line4: When placed next to a normal furnace, this thermal energy will provide the furnace heat without consuming fuel.{0}
manual.external_heater.line5: The sides of the heater can be configured with the Engineer's Hammer, sneak to target the opposing side.{0}
manual.external_heater.line6: The heater will consume 8 Flux/t for each furnace it needs to heat. To preheat the furnace, it will take four times that, until the furnace is at temperature.{0}
manual.external_heater.line7: When a furnace is at maximum temperature, the External Heater will consume a total §o32 Flux/t§r per furnace for increased smelting speed, unless a redstone signal disables the speed boost.{0}
manual.external_heater.line8: Only furnaces which have items to smelt and space to smelt them will be heated.
